words.tr: phrase. 塑造一种积极的世界观
words.ex: He tries to shape a positive world view by reading inspiring stories.
words.ex_cn: 他通过阅读鼓舞人心的故事来培养积极的世界观。
words.en: To form a constructive and optimistic perspective on life and society.

words.tr: phrase. 中等教育；中学教育
words.ex: He finished secondary education last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年完成了中学教育。
words.en: Secondary education refers to the stage of education following primary education and preceding tertiary education. It typically includes middle and high school education, aimed at preparing students for higher education or vocational training.

words.ex: He completed primary education in his hometown.
words.ex_cn: 他在家乡完成了小学教育。
words.en: Primary education refers to the first stage of formal education, coming after preschool and before secondary education. It is typically provided to children aged between 5 and 11.

words.ex: He acquired a new skill last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年获得了一项新技能。
words.en: If you acquire something, you buy or obtain it for yourself, or someone gives it to you.

words.ex: He is lazy and doesn't like to do homework.
words.ex_cn: 他很懒，不喜欢做作业。
words.en: If someone is lazy, they are not willing to work or use any effort to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 综合技能；全面的能力
words.ex: He has comprehensive skills in math and writing.
words.ex_cn: 他具备数学和写作方面的综合技能。
words.en: A wide range of abilities and competencies, covering many different areas.

words.tr: phrase. 同伴影响；同龄人影响力；同辈压力
words.ex: Peer influence can make teens smoke or drink.
words.ex_cn: 同龄人的影响会让青少年吸烟或喝酒。
words.en: The effect that people of the same age or social group have on each other's attitudes and behaviour.

words.tr: phrase. 掌握技能；理解并熟练运用某种能力
words.ex: It takes time and practice to grasp skills in a new field.
words.ex_cn: 掌握新领域的技能需要时间和实践。
words.en: To acquire and master practical abilities or competencies.

words.tr: adj. 多方面的；有多种技能的；
words.ex: He is a versatile player who can play many positions.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名多方面的运动员，能打多个位置。
words.en: Able to adapt or be adapted to many different functions or activities.

words.tr: phrase. 职业训练；职业培训
words.ex: He is doing vocational training to become a mechanic.
words.ex_cn: 他正在接受职业培训，以成为一名机械师。
words.en: Vocational training refers to instructional programs or courses that focus on the skills required for a particular job function or trade.

words.ex: Parents should cultivate morality and virtue in their children.
words.ex_cn: 父母应该在孩子身上培养道德和美德。
words.en: To foster and develop ethical principles and virtuous character.

words.tr: phrase. 集体活动；共同参与的行动或事件
words.ex: The class joined collective activities every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 这个班级每周五都参加集体活动。
words.en: Activities that are done by a group of people together, rather than individually, often aimed at achieving a common goal.

words.ex: The obedient child cleaned his room without being told.
words.ex_cn: 这个听话的孩子没被要求就打扫了房间。
words.en: An obedient person or animal does what they are told to do.

words.tr: phrase. 培养守法公民；培育遵守法律的市民
words.ex: Schools should nurture law-abiding citizens through good education.
words.ex_cn: 学校应该通过良好的教育培养守法公民。
words.en: To raise and educate individuals who respect and adhere to laws.

words.tr: phrase. 理论知识；指基于原理、概念或抽象推理而非实践经验的知识
words.ex: He has a lot of theoretical knowledge but little experience.
words.ex_cn: 他有很多理论知识，但缺乏经验。
words.en: Theoretical knowledge refers to knowledge that is based on theory rather than practice or experience. It involves understanding the principles and concepts that underlie a subject or field of study.

words.tr: phrase. 榜样；模范人物；可供效仿的典范
words.ex: My parents are my role models.
words.ex_cn: 我的父母是我的榜样。
words.en: A role model is a person who serves as an example by exhibiting behaviors or qualities that are emulated by others.

words.tr: adj. 自律的；自我约束的
words.ex: He is self-disciplinary and wakes up early every day.
words.ex_cn: 他自律，每天早起。
words.en: Relating to or characterized by the ability to control one's own behavior and impulses.

words.ex: He will participate in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他将参与学校的戏剧演出。
words.en: To take part in an activity or event.

words.tr: phrase. 强调；着重于；把重点放在
words.ex: Schools should place emphasis on reading and writing.
words.ex_cn: 学校应该重视读写能力。
words.en: To give special importance or attention to something.

words.ex: There is strong competition between the two companies.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司之间竞争激烈。
words.en: Competition is a situation in which two or more people or groups are trying to get something which not everyone can have.

words.tr: phrase. 多种的；各种各样的
words.ex: He eats a variety of fruits every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃各种各样的水果。
words.en: A number or range of things of the same general class that are different or distinct in character or quality.

words.tr: phrase. 区分对与错；辨别是非
words.ex: Children must learn to distinguish right from wrong.
words.ex_cn: 孩子必须学会分辨对错。
words.en: To tell the difference between what is morally right and wrong.

words.ex: He feels weak after the long illness.
words.ex_cn: 这场大病之后，他感到虚弱。
words.en: If someone is weak, they are not physically strong or healthy.

words.tr: phrase. 挖掘某人的潜力；发挥某人的潜能
words.ex: Everyone can expand one's potential with hard work.
words.ex_cn: 每个人都可以通过努力扩展自己的潜力。
words.en: To develop or increase someone's abilities or possibilities.

words.ex: He is greedy and always wants more candy.
words.ex_cn: 他很贪婪，总是想要更多的糖果。
words.en: If you describe someone as greedy, you mean that they want to have more of something such as food or money than is necessary or fair.

words.tr: phrase. 培养沟通技巧；发展交流能力
words.ex: To succeed in this role, you must develop communicative skills that allow you to effectively share ideas and collaborate with others.
words.ex_cn: 为了在这个角色中取得成功，你必须培养沟通技能，使你能够有效地分享想法并与他人合作。
words.en: To enhance the ability to express ideas and interact effectively.

words.ex: Each child shows their individuality in different ways.
words.ex_cn: 每个孩子都以不同的方式展现他们的个性。
words.en: The qualities that make someone or something different from others.

words.tr: adj. 专门的；专业的； v. “specialize”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He has a specialized job in computer repair.
words.ex_cn: 他的工作是专门修理电脑的。
words.en: Requiring or involving detailed and specific knowledge or training.

words.ex: He ignored the warning sign.
words.ex_cn: 他忽视了警告标志。
words.en: If you ignore someone or something, you pay no attention to them.

words.ex: He wants to get high education in another country.
words.ex_cn: 他想在另一个国家接受高等教育。
words.en: Education at a college or university level, especially leading to a degree.

words.tr: phrase. 激发学习兴趣与动机
words.ex: Teachers use various methods to stimulate learning interests and motivation among students.
words.ex_cn: 教师使用各种方法来激发学生的学习兴趣和动力。
words.en: To arouse and sustain curiosity and eagerness to learn.

words.tr: phrase. 识字水平；读写能力水平；文化程度
words.ex: His literacy level improved after taking the course.
words.ex_cn: 他上完这门课后，识字水平提高了。
words.en: The ability to read and write at a level adequate for communication, or at a level that enables an individual to comprehend and use printed material in daily activities.

words.ex: He is diligent in doing his homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都很勤奋地做作业。
words.en: Someone who is diligent works hard and is careful and thorough.

words.tr: phrase. 以学生为中心的教学方法
words.ex: The teacher uses a student-centered teaching approach in class.
words.ex_cn: 老师在课堂上使用以学生为中心的教学方法。

words.ex: The teacher instructed the students to open their books.
words.ex_cn: 老师指示学生打开书。
words.en: To instruct someone means to tell or teach them to do something, especially in a formal or official way.

words.tr: 短语动词. 将知识应用于实践中
words.ex: He applies the knowledge into practice every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天把知识运用到实践中。
words.en: To use learned information or theories in real-world situations.

words.ex: The two companies showed good cooperation on the project.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司在这个项目上表现出良好的合作。
words.en: Cooperation is the process of working or acting together, which can be seen in many aspects of life, including business, science, and social interactions.

words.tr: adj. 不服从的；违背的；不孝的
words.ex: The child was disobedient and refused to clean his room.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子不听话，拒绝打扫房间。
words.en: If someone is disobedient, they deliberately do not do what someone in authority tells them to do, or what a rule or law says they should do.

words.tr: 短语动词. 获得体面且薪酬优厚的工作
words.uk: get dɪˈsent ənd wel peɪd dʒɒbs
words.us: get dɪˈsɛnt ənd wɛl peɪd dʒɑːbz
words.ex: Students study hard to get decent and well-paid jobs.
words.ex_cn: 学生们努力学习，以获得体面且高薪的工作。
words.en: To obtain respectable and financially rewarding employment.

words.ex: He is selfish and never shares his toys.
words.ex_cn: 他很自私，从不分享他的玩具。
words.en: If you say that someone is selfish, you mean that they only care about their own interests and do not consider the needs or feelings of other people.

words.tr: adj. 杰出的；尚未处理的；
words.ex: He is an outstanding student who always gets top grades.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名杰出的学生，总是取得最高分。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as outstanding, you think that they are very remarkable and impressive.

words.tr: phrase. 以职业为导向的教育模式；强调培养学生职业技能和就业能力的教育方式
words.ex: The school uses a career-oriented educational mode to prepare students for jobs.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校采用以职业为导向的教育模式来为学生就业做准备。
words.en: An educational approach that is designed to prepare students for specific careers, focusing on practical skills and knowledge relevant to the job market.

words.tr: phrase. 提高生产力；增加生产效率
words.ex: The new machine helps increase productivity.
words.ex_cn: 这台新机器有助于提高生产率。
words.en: To enhance the efficiency and output of work or production, often by improving methods, tools, or processes.

words.tr: adj. 需要久坐的；惯于久坐不动的；不爱活动的；
words.ex: His sedentary job makes him sit all day.
words.ex_cn: 他的久坐工作让他整天坐着。
words.en: Someone who has a sedentary lifestyle or job sits down a lot of the time and does not take much exercise.

words.tr: phrase. 科学上的重大突破；科学领域取得的革命性进展
words.ex: The scientist made a scientific breakthrough last year.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家去年取得了科学突破。
words.en: A scientific breakthrough is a significant and often unexpected discovery or development in the field of science that leads to new knowledge or technology.

words.ex: This software is availableaccessible for all users.
words.ex_cn: 这个软件对所有用户都是可用可访问的。

words.ex: The storm caused unprecedented damage.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴造成了前所未有的破坏。
words.en: If something is unprecedented, it has never happened before.

words.ex: The door opens automatically when you get close.
words.ex_cn: 当你靠近时，门会自动打开。
words.en: If something happens automatically, it happens as a part of the normal process or system, without needing to be started by someone.

words.ex: The police started an investigation into the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警方对这起事故展开了调查。
words.en: An investigation is a careful search or examination in order to discover facts or information.

words.tr: adj. 压倒的；无法抗拒的；势不可挡的； v. “overwhelm”的现在分词；
words.ex: The crowd's cheers were overwhelming.
words.ex_cn: 人群的欢呼声压倒了一切。
words.en: If something is overwhelming, it affects you very strongly, and you do not know how to deal with it.

words.ex: He is doing scientific research in the lab.
words.ex_cn: 他正在实验室做科学研究。

words.ex: The country strengthened its military defense last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年，这个国家加强了军事防御。
words.en: The use of armed forces and weapons to protect a country against enemies.

words.tr: phrase. 使利润最大化；把收益提高到最大程度
words.ex: The company tries to maximize profits by selling more products.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司试图通过销售更多产品来最大化利润。
words.en: To maximize profits means to increase profits to the greatest extent possible.

words.ex: We must ensure sustainable development for future generations.
words.ex_cn: 我们必须为子孙后代确保可持续发展。
words.en: To ensure sustainable development means to make certain that development meets the needs of the present without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs.

words.tr: adj. 普遍的；流行的；盛行的；
words.ex: Smoking is prevalent in that country.
words.ex_cn: 在那个国家，吸烟很普遍。
words.en: If a condition, practice, or belief is prevalent, it is common or widespread.

words.tr: phrase. 医学研究；医学学习
words.ex: He is doing medical study at the university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学里进行医学学习。
words.en: Medical study refers to the systematic investigation into and study of materials and sources in order to establish facts and reach new conclusions in the field of medicine.

words.tr: adj.能力消耗的; 耗能的; 费精力的
words.ex: This machine is energy-consuming.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器耗能。
words.en: Requiring a large amount of energy.

words.tr: phrase. 太空探索；对宇宙空间的科学探测与研究
words.ex: NASA is doing space exploration to learn about other planets.
words.ex_cn: 美国宇航局正在进行太空探索，以了解其他行星。
words.en: The investigation of physical conditions in space and on stars, planets, and other celestial bodies through the use of satellites, space probes, or spacecraft with human crews.

words.tr: phrase. 取代人工劳动；用自动化手段替代手工操作
words.ex: The robot will replace manual work in the factory.
words.ex_cn: 机器人将取代工厂里的手工劳动。
words.en: To substitute automated or mechanical processes for tasks previously done by hand.

words.ex: Video games are money-consuming.
words.ex_cn: 电子游戏很费钱。
words.en: Requiring a lot of money to be spent.

words.tr: phrase. 保持即时联系；维持瞬时沟通
words.ex: They use phones to maintain instant contact.
words.ex_cn: 他们用电话保持即时联系。
words.en: To keep in immediate communication with someone or something.

words.ex: Exercise can enhance your health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以提高你的健康。
words.en: To enhance something means to improve its value, quality, or attractiveness.

words.ex: We need to reduce waste in our daily life.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要减少日常生活中的浪费。
words.en: If you reduce something, you make it smaller in size or amount, or less in degree.

words.tr: adj. 懒惰的；懒散的；好逸恶劳的
words.ex: He is indolent and never does his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他很懒，从不做作业。
words.en: If you describe someone as indolent, you mean that they are lazy.

words.ex: Doing homework by hand is time-consuming.
words.ex_cn: 手写作业很耗时。
words.en: If you describe an activity as time-consuming, you mean that it takes a lot of time to do.

words.tr: adj. 被污染的； v. “pollute”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The river is polluted by factory waste.
words.ex_cn: 这条河被工厂废料污染了。
words.en: If something is polluted, it is made dirty or harmful, usually because of chemicals or waste.

words.tr: adj. 先进的；高级的； v. 提前；前进；“advance”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: This school uses advanced technology in classrooms.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校在教室里使用先进的技术。
words.en: An advanced system, method, or design is modern and has been developed from an earlier version of the same thing.

words.tr: phrase. 抵抗不利的自然条件；抵御恶劣的自然环境
words.ex: Cacti can resist unfavorable natural conditions.
words.ex_cn: 仙人掌能够抵抗不利的自然条件。
words.en: To withstand or endure adverse environmental or physical conditions.

words.ex: The new factory will boost economic prosperity.
words.ex_cn: 这家新工厂将促进经济繁荣。
words.en: To increase or improve the economic prosperity of a country or region.

words.ex: The car moved at a rapid speed.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车以迅速的速度行驶。
words.en: A rapid change or event happens very quickly.

words.ex: Smartphones bring remarkable convenience to our daily lives.
words.ex_cn: 智能手机给我们的日常生活带来了极大的便利。
words.en: To provide significant ease or advantage in performing tasks or activities.

words.w: overcome time restriction and geographical barrier
words.tr: phrase. 克服时间限制与地理障碍
words.uk: ˌəʊvəˈkʌm taɪm rɪˈstrɪkʃn ænd dʒiˈɒɡrəfɪk ˈbɑːrɪər
words.us: ˌoʊvərˈkʌm taɪm rɪˈstrɪkʃn ænd dʒiˈɑːɡrəfɪk ˈbærɪər
words.ex: The online class helps students overcome time restriction and geographical barrier.
words.ex_cn: 在线课程帮助学生克服时间限制和地理障碍。
words.en: To surmount limitations of time and distance that hinder activities or communication.

words.ex: The news coverage showed the big flood.
words.ex_cn: 新闻报道展示了这场大洪水。
words.en: The reporting of news and events in newspapers, on television, or on the radio.

words.ex: The viewing rate of the video is high.
words.ex_cn: 这个视频的观看率很高。
words.en: The viewing rate refers to the percentage of the total potential audience that watches a particular television program or channel at a given time.

words.tr: adj. 公正的；不偏不倚的；
words.ex: The judge was impartial in the trial.
words.ex_cn: 法官在审判中是公正的。
words.en: Someone who is impartial is not directly involved in a particular situation, and is therefore able to give a fair opinion or decision about it.

words.ex: The scandal made the news last week.
words.ex_cn: 这起丑闻上周上了新闻。
words.en: A scandal is a situation or event that is thought to be shocking and immoral and that everyone knows about.

words.ex: The letter revealed his secret.
words.ex_cn: 这封信揭露了他的秘密。
words.en: To reveal something means to make known something that was previously secret or unknown.

words.ex: The village is isolated from the city by mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄被山脉与城市隔开。
words.en: To be separated from others or from a group, often to prevent the spread of disease or to keep someone away from social interactions.

words.ex: The mirror distorts my face.
words.ex_cn: 这面镜子扭曲了我的脸。
words.en: If you distort a statement, fact, or idea, you report or represent it in an untrue way.

words.tr: phrase. 点击率，指在网页或广告中被点击的次数与展示次数的比率
words.ex: The clicking rate of the ad increased last week.
words.ex_cn: 这个广告的点击率上周提高了。
words.en: The clicking rate refers to the number of clicks on a specific link or advertisement divided by the number of times it was shown, expressed as a percentage.

words.tr: phrase. 被……吸引；对……产生兴趣
words.ex: He is attracted by the bright colors of the painting.
words.ex_cn: 他被这幅画的鲜艳色彩吸引。
words.en: To be drawn to or interested in someone or something.

words.tr: adj. 有极大诱惑力的；不可抵抗的；
words.ex: The chocolate cake looked irresistible.
words.ex_cn: 那块巧克力蛋糕看起来极具诱惑力。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as irresistible, you mean that they are so good or attractive that you cannot stop yourself from liking them or wanting them.

words.tr: phrase. 社交网络网站；指用于用户建立社交关系、分享内容和互动的在线平台
words.ex: He uses social network websites to talk with friends.
words.ex_cn: 他使用社交网站和朋友聊天。
words.en: Websites that allow users to create and share content or to participate in social networking.

words.tr: phrase. 走入歧途；堕落；丢失；被盗
words.ex: He went astray after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后走上了歧途。
words.en: If someone goes astray, they no longer follow the right course of action or the right way of life.

words.ex: He was lured by the promise of a high salary.
words.ex_cn: 他被高薪的承诺所诱惑。
words.en: To be attracted or tempted by something, often something that is appealing but potentially harmful or deceptive.

words.ex: The story was fabricated to trick people.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事是虚构的，目的是欺骗人们。
words.en: If something is fabricated, it is not true or does not exist, but someone wants you to believe that it is true or that it exists.

words.ex: Watching movies is a popular entertainment.
words.ex_cn: 看电影是一种流行的休闲娱乐。
words.en: Entertainment refers to performances or activities that are intended to amuse or interest an audience.

words.tr: adj. 耸人听闻的；极好的；
words.ex: The newspaper published a sensational story about a ghost.
words.ex_cn: 这家报纸刊登了一篇关于幽灵的耸人听闻的消息。
words.en: A sensational event or situation is so remarkable that it causes great excitement and interest.

words.tr: adj. 吸引人的；诱人的； v. “tempt”的现在分词；
words.ex: The smell of fresh bread is very tempting.
words.ex_cn: 新鲜面包的香味非常诱人。
words.en: If something is tempting, it makes you feel that you want to have it or do it.

words.ex: The worker had long exposure to loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 这名工人长期暴露在噪音中。
words.en: The condition of being exposed to something, especially to something harmful or unpleasant.

words.ex: The storm is a threat to the village.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴对村庄构成了威胁。
words.en: A threat is a statement of an intention to inflict pain, injury, damage, or other hostile action on someone in retribution for something done or not done.

words.tr: adj. 夸张的；夸大的；言过其实的； v. 夸张；夸大；“exaggerate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: His story was exaggerated and not true.
words.ex_cn: 他的故事是夸张的，不真实的。
words.en: If you describe something as exaggerated, you mean that it is described as being worse or better than it really is.

words.tr: phrase. 激发购买欲望；引起购物需求
words.ex: The ad helps to generate purchasing desire.
words.ex_cn: 这则广告有助于激发购买欲望。
words.en: To create or stimulate a consumer's desire to buy a product.

words.tr: phrase. 新闻审查；对新闻报道的审查与管制
words.ex: The government practices news censorship to control information.
words.ex_cn: 政府通过新闻审查来控制信息。
words.en: The practice of suppressing or restricting access to news or information, often by a government or other authority.

words.ex: He is still immature and often cries when upset.
words.ex_cn: 他仍然不成熟，生气时经常哭。
words.en: If you describe someone as immature, you are criticizing them because they do not behave in a sensible or responsible way, or because they have not developed emotionally or mentally to the level that is normal for their age.

words.ex: It is important to eat healthy food.
words.ex_cn: 吃健康的食物很重要。
words.en: Something that is important is very significant, is highly valued, or is necessary.

words.tr: adj. 误导的； v. “mislead”的现在分词；
words.ex: The ad is misleading because it shows fake results.
words.ex_cn: 这个广告是误导的，因为它展示了虚假的结果。
words.en: If you describe something as misleading, you mean that it gives you a wrong idea or impression.

words.ex: It is inconceivable that he forgot his own birthday.
words.ex_cn: 他忘了自己生日，这简直难以想象。
words.en: If something is inconceivable, it is impossible to imagine or believe because it is so unlikely.

words.ex: The circulation number of this magazine is 50,000.
words.ex_cn: 这本杂志的发行量是五万。
words.en: The term 'circulation number' refers to the quantity of copies of a publication that are distributed or sold.

words.tr: phrase. 公共事务；对外事务；政府与公众之间的沟通事务
words.ex: She has a deep understanding of public affairs.
words.ex_cn: 她对公共事务有深刻的理解。
words.en: Public affairs refer to matters of public interest or concern, often involving government policies, community issues, and societal welfare.

words.tr: phrase. 模仿不当行为；仿效违规行为
words.ex: He tries to imitate misconducts of his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他试图模仿同学的不当行为。
words.en: To copy or mimic the wrong or improper actions of others.

words.tr: phrase. 认知能力；指个体处理信息、理解事物、解决问题和进行逻辑推理等心理技能的综合水平
words.ex: He shows strong cognitive competence in solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决数学问题时表现出很强的认知能力。
words.en: Cognitive competence refers to the ability of an individual to process information, understand complex ideas, and apply knowledge effectively.

words.tr:
v. 包括；遮盖；报道；
n. 遮盖物；庇护所；封面；
words.ex: The book covers basic math and science.
words.ex_cn: 这本书包括基础数学和科学。
words.en: If something covers something else, it has been placed over or upon it, usually in order to protect it or hide it.

words.ex: The mass media shows news every day.
words.ex_cn: 大众媒体每天播放新闻。
words.en: The mass media refers to the various means by which information is communicated to large numbers of people, including newspapers, magazines, television, and the internet.

words.ex: The company uses social media to shapebuild brand image.
words.ex_cn: 该公司利用社交媒体塑造品牌形象。

words.ex: He is addicted to playing video games.
words.ex_cn: 他沉迷于玩电子游戏。
words.en: If someone is addicted to something, they are unable to stop doing it or using it, even though it may be harmful to them.

words.tr: adj. 虚拟的；几乎的；实际上的；事实上的；
words.ex: He played a virtual game on his computer.
words.ex_cn: 他在电脑上玩了一个虚拟游戏。
words.en: If you describe something as virtual, you mean that it is so nearly true that for most purposes it can be regarded as true.

words.ex: The gossip about the CEO made everyone shocked.
words.ex_cn: 关于CEO的流言蜚语让所有人都震惊了。
words.en: Gossip is informal conversation or reports about other people's private lives, which might be unkind or not true.

words.tr: phrase. 扩大潜在消费者群体；拓展可能的消费人群
words.ex: The company plans to expand potential consumer groups by lowering prices.
words.ex_cn: 该公司计划通过降价来扩大潜在消费者群体。
words.en: To increase the number of possible customers or target audience for a product or service.

words.ex: He wants to study journalism after high school.
words.ex_cn: 他想在高中后学习新闻工作。
words.en: The profession or practice of reporting about, photographing, or editing news stories for one of the mass media.

words.ex: The accident was newsworthy because many people were hurt.
words.ex_cn: 这次事故很有新闻价值，因为很多人受伤了。
words.en: If something is newsworthy, it is interesting enough to be reported as news.

words.tr: phrase. 做出非理性的决定；做出不理智的决定
words.ex: He made irrational decisions when he was angry.
words.ex_cn: 他生气时做出了不理性的决定。
words.en: To make decisions that are not based on logical reasoning or sound judgment.

chapters.name: 写作词测 4（政府与社会发展类）

words.ex: The teacher will distribute the books to students.
words.ex_cn: 老师将把书分发给学生。
words.en: If you distribute things, you hand them or deliver them to a number of people.

words.tr: phrase. 人口的爆炸性增长；人口激增
words.ex: The explosion of population has made cities crowded.
words.ex_cn: 人口的激增使城市变得拥挤。
words.en: A sudden and rapid increase in the number of people in a particular area.

words.ex: Good sports events can help shape national image.
words.ex_cn: 好的体育赛事有助于塑造国家形象。
words.en: To influence or determine the way a country is perceived by others.

words.tr: phrase. + n. 执行管理；强制实施管理措施
words.ex: The company decided to enforce management policies more strictly.
words.ex_cn: 公司决定更严格地执行管理政策。
words.en: To ensure that management policies or rules are carried out effectively and strictly.

words.tr: phrase. 破旧的房子；年久失修的房子
words.ex: The rundown house at the end of the street is up for sale.
words.ex_cn: 街道尽头的那栋破旧房子正在出售。
words.en: A rundown house is a building that is in a state of disrepair or decay, often due to neglect or age.

words.tr: phrase. 残酷的竞争；激烈的竞争
words.ex: The market has cutting-throat competition among companies.
words.ex_cn: 市场上公司之间的竞争非常残酷。

words.ex: The teacher intervened when the students argued.
words.ex_cn: 当学生们争吵时，老师进行了干涉。
words.en: If you intervene in a situation, you become involved in it and try to change it.

words.tr: phrase. 进行周全的考虑；仔细斟酌
words.ex: Before making a decision, it is important to take thorough consideration of all the factors involved.
words.ex_cn: 在做出决定之前，充分考虑所有相关因素是很重要的。
words.en: To carefully think about and evaluate all aspects of a situation or decision.

words.ex: The skyscraper is very tall and has many floors.
words.ex_cn: 这座摩天大楼非常高，有很多层。
words.en: A skyscraper is a very tall building that has many floors.

words.ex: The mobilitymovement of population affects urban planning.
words.ex_cn: 人口流动影响城市规划。

words.tr: n. 权威；官方机构；权力；权威人士；当局；
words.ex: The teacher is an authority on ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 这位老师是古代史方面的权威。
words.en: The power to make decisions or enforce rules.

words.ex: The school will assign experts to help students.
words.ex_cn: 学校将指派专家来帮助学生。
words.en: Designate specialists to particular tasks or responsibilities.

words.ex: The government works to popularize education in rural areas.
words.ex_cn: 政府努力在农村地区普及教育。

words.ex: He was late because of a traffic jam.
words.ex_cn: 他因为交通堵塞迟到了。
words.en: A traffic jam is a long line of vehicles that cannot move forward because there is too much traffic, or because the road is blocked by something.

words.tr: phrase. 社会疏离与孤立（指个体在社会关系中感到被排斥、脱离或孤独的状态）
words.ex: He feels social alienation and isolation after moving to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 他搬到新城市后感到社会疏离和孤独。
words.en: Social alienation and isolation refer to the state of being separated from society or feeling disconnected from others, often leading to feelings of loneliness and exclusion.

words.tr: adj. 自命不凡的；自负的；矫饰的
words.ex: He wore a fancy hat to seem pretentious.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一顶华丽的帽子，显得自命不凡。
words.en: If you describe something as pretentious, you mean that it is intended to seem important or significant, but you think it is not.

words.tr: phrase. 确保社会稳定；保障社会安定
words.ex: The government works to ensure social stability.
words.ex_cn: 政府努力确保社会稳定。
words.en: To make certain that society remains stable and orderly.

words.w: the gap between the wealthy and the needy
words.tr: phrase. 富人与穷人之间的差距
words.uk: ðə ɡæp bɪˈtwiːn ðə ˈwelθi ənd ðə ˈniːdi
words.us: ðə ɡæp bɪˈtwin ðə ˈwɛlθi ənd ðə ˈnidi
words.ex: The gap between the wealthy and the needy is getting wider.
words.ex_cn: 富人和穷人之间的差距正在变大。
words.en: The disparity in wealth and resources between the rich and the poor.

words.ex: The campaign aims to arouse public awareness about environmental protection.
words.ex_cn: v. 该运动旨在唤起公众对环境保护的意识。
words.en: To make the public aware of something, especially an important issue or problem.

words.ex: The authoritativeness of the professor's lecture was unquestionable.
words.ex_cn: 教授讲座的权威性无可置疑。
words.en: The quality of being authoritative; commanding and self-confident; likely to be respected and obeyed.

words.tr: phrase. 物质主义的；唯利是图的；拜金的
v. 得到；获得；使；变得；收到；
words.ex: I got a new book from the library.
words.ex_cn: 我从图书馆得到了一本新书。
words.en: To come into possession of something; to receive or be given something.

words.ex: The company wants to set a universal standard for safety.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司想设立一个通用的安全标准。
words.en: To establish a benchmark or criterion that is applicable and relevant to all people or situations universally.

words.w: maintain the rights and benefits of taxpayers
words.tr: 维护纳税人的权利和利益
words.uk: meɪnˈteɪn ðə raɪts ænd ˈbenɪfɪts ɒv ˈtækspeɪəz
words.us: meɪnˈteɪn ðə raɪts ænd ˈbenɪfɪts ʌv ˈtæksperz
words.ex: The law helps to maintain the rights and benefits of taxpayers.
words.ex_cn: 这项法律有助于维护纳税人的权利和利益。
words.en: To protect and uphold the legal entitlements and advantages of individuals who pay taxes.

words.ex: He got involved in the school play last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月参加了学校的戏剧表演。
words.en: To become a part of or participate in an activity or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 签发保单；出具保险单
words.ex: The government will issue policy to help small businesses.
words.ex_cn: 政府将发布政策来帮助小企业。
words.en: An issue policy refers to the set of rules or guidelines established by an organization or government regarding the distribution or release of something, such as documents, financial instruments, or regulations.

words.ex: The bright light stimulated her eyes.
words.ex_cn: 强烈的光线刺激了她的眼睛。
words.en: To stimulate something means to encourage it to begin or develop further.

words.ex: The city is facing problems because of rapid urbanization.
words.ex_cn: 由于快速的城市化，这座城市正面临问题。
words.en: The process by which more and more people leave the countryside to live in cities.

words.ex: Please ensure the door is locked.
words.ex_cn: 请确保门锁好了。
words.en: To make certain that something will occur or be the case.

words.ex: They need to raise an adequate amount of money for the school trip.
words.ex_cn: 他们需要为学校旅行筹集足够的钱。
words.en: To generate or collect a sufficient sum of money for a specific purpose or need.

words.tr: phrase. 牺牲健康与幸福；以健康和快乐为代价
words.ex: He was willing to sacrifice health and happiness for his career.
words.ex_cn: 他愿意为了事业牺牲健康和幸福。
words.en: To give up health and happiness for something considered more important.

words.ex: Migrant workers often face challenges in finding stable employment.
words.ex_cn: 流动工人常常在寻找稳定工作时面临挑战。
words.en: A migrant worker is a person who moves from one place to another, often from one country to another, in search of work.

words.tr: v. 加速；加快；“accelerate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He accelerated the car to pass the truck.
words.ex_cn: 他加速开车超过卡车。
words.en: Increased in speed or happening more quickly than usual.

words.ex: He feels weak after the long illness.
words.ex_cn: 这场大病之后，他感到虚弱。
words.en: If someone is weak, they are not physically strong or healthy.

words.ex: The teacher will not condone cheating in exams.
words.ex_cn: 老师不会容忍考试作弊。
words.en: To condone something means to accept or allow behavior that is considered wrong.

words.ex: The forest keeps the ecological balance.
words.ex_cn: 森林维持着生态平衡。
words.en: Ecological balance refers to the state of equilibrium within a community of organisms in which genetic, species, and ecosystem diversity remain relatively stable, subject to gradual changes through natural succession.

words.ex: The scarcity shortage of energy is a big problem.
words.ex_cn: 能源的短缺是一个大问题。

words.ex: The house has high energy consumption in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子在冬天耗能很高。
words.en: The use of energy by a particular group or society.

words.tr: phrase. 化石燃料（如煤、石油和天然气）
words.ex: Cars use fossil fuels to move.
words.ex_cn: 汽车使用化石燃料来行驶。
words.en: Fossil fuels are natural fuels such as coal or gas, formed in the geological past from the remains of living organisms.

words.tr: n. 可回收再利用的物品；可重复使用的产品（由 "recycle" 和 "reuse" 组合而成，表示可循环再用的物品）
words.ex: We recycle plastic bottles and reuse them as plant pots.
words.ex_cn: 我们回收塑料瓶并把它们再利用成花盆。
words.en: To process used materials into new products or to use them again in their original form.

words.ex: The ozone layer protects us from the sun's harmful rays.
words.ex_cn: 臭氧层保护我们免受太阳有害射线的伤害。
words.en: The ozone layer is a layer in the Earth's stratosphere that contains a high concentration of ozone (O3) molecules, which absorb most of the Sun's harmful ultraviolet radiation.

words.ex: Factories cause carbon emission into the air.
words.ex_cn: 工厂向空气中排放二氧化碳。
words.en: The release of carbon dioxide into the atmosphere, primarily from burning fossil fuels.

words.ex: Heavy rain causes soil erosion on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 大雨导致山坡上的土壤侵蚀。
words.en: The process by which the surface of the earth is worn away by the action of water, glaciers, winds, waves, etc.

words.ex: The public condemned the corrupt politician.
words.ex_cn: 公众谴责了这位腐败的政客。
words.en: If you condemn something, you say that it is very bad and unacceptable.

words.ex: Overgrazing causes desertification in dry areas.
words.ex_cn: 过度放牧会导致干旱地区的沙漠化。
words.en: Desertification is the process by which fertile land becomes desert, typically as a result of drought, deforestation, or inappropriate agriculture.

words.tr: adj. 肥沃的；有繁殖力的；多产的；富饶的；
words.ex: The fertile land grows many crops.
words.ex_cn: 这片肥沃的土地长满了各种作物。
words.en: Land or soil that is fertile is able to support the growth of a large number of strong healthy plants.

words.ex: The city cleaned the sewage from the streets.
words.ex_cn: 城市清理了街道上的污水。
words.en: Sewage is waste matter such as faeces or dirty water from homes and factories, which flows away through sewers.

words.ex: The soil is too infertile to grow crops.
words.ex_cn: 这片土地太贫瘠了，无法种植庄稼。
words.en: Infertile land or soil is not able to produce good crops or plants. An infertile person, animal, or plant cannot have babies, eggs, or seeds.

words.ex: Environmental pollutioncontamination is harmful to health.
words.ex_cn: 环境污染污染对健康有害。

words.tr: phrase. 水土保持；指为防止水土流失、保护和合理利用水土资源而采取的措施
words.ex: Farmers practice water and soil conservation to protect the land.
words.ex_cn: 农民进行水土保持以保护土地。
words.en: The protection and management of water and soil resources to prevent erosion and degradation.

words.tr: n. 采伐森林；森林开伐；
words.ex: Deforestation is killing many animals.
words.ex_cn: 采伐森林正在杀死许多动物。
words.en: The act of cutting down or burning all the trees in an area.

words.ex: The forest has high biodiversity.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林生物多样性很高。
words.en: Biodiversity refers to the variety of life in the world or in a particular habitat or ecosystem.

words.tr: phrase. 环保的，对环境友好的
n./v. 释放；发布；松开；放松；释放令

words.ex: We must protect natural resources conservation for future generations.
words.ex_cn: 我们必须保护自然资源的节约，以造福后代。
words.en: The protection and careful management of natural assets like water, forests, and minerals.

words.tr: adj. 不可生物降解的；无法被自然分解的
words.ex: Plastic bags are non-biodegradable and harm the environment.
words.ex_cn: 塑料袋是非生物降解的，会对环境造成危害。
words.en: Not capable of being broken down naturally by microorganisms.

words.ex: Farmers grow tomatoes in a greenhouse.
words.ex_cn: 农民在温室里种植番茄。
words.en: A greenhouse is a building with glass walls and roof; for the cultivation and exhibition of plants under controlled conditions.

words.ex: Too many people put pressure on resources in this city.
words.ex_cn: 太多人给这个城市的资源带来了压力。
words.en: To strain or overuse available supplies or capabilities.

words.ex: The town uses solar power for sustainable development.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇使用太阳能来实现可持续发展。
words.en: Sustainable development refers to development that meets the needs of the present without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs.

words.tr: phrase. 可再生资源；可更新资源
words.ex: Solar energy is a renewable resource.
words.ex_cn: 太阳能是一种可再生资源。
words.en: Renewable resources are natural resources that can be replenished naturally over time, such as sunlight, wind, rain, tides, and geothermal heat.

chapters.name: 写作词测 6（犯罪与法律类）

words.tr: phrase. 攻击性和暴力行为；指具有敌意、侵略性或伤害他人的行为表现
words.ex: The police were called to deal with aggressive and violent behaviors in the neighborhood.
words.ex_cn: 警察被叫来处理社区中的挑衅和暴力行为。
words.en: Hostile, forceful, and physically or verbally harmful actions.

words.ex: The heavy fine is a deterrent to cheating.
words.ex_cn: 高额罚款是一种威慑作弊的力量。
words.en: Something that discourages or is intended to discourage someone from doing something.

words.ex: He hired a legal lawyer to help him.
words.ex_cn: 他请了一位法律律师来帮助他。
words.en: Relating to the law or to lawyers, or permitted or required by law.

words.ex: He is in rehabilitation after his surgery.
words.ex_cn: 他术后正在康复。
words.en: Rehabilitation is the process of helping someone to have a normal, useful life again after they have been very ill or in prison, or the process of returning a building or area to its previous good condition.

words.tr: phrase. 非常任性的；固执的

words.ex: It is illegal to drive without a license.
words.ex_cn: 无证驾驶是非法的。
words.en: If something is illegal, the law says that it is not allowed.

words.ex: The legislator voted for a new law.
words.ex_cn: 这位立法者投票支持了一项新法律。
words.en: A legislator is a person who is a member of a legislature, especially in a democratic country.

words.ex: He noticed the discrimination between the two prices.
words.ex_cn: 他注意到了两个价格之间的区别。
words.en: The unjust or prejudicial treatment of different categories of people, especially on the grounds of race, age, or sex.

words.ex: The rebellious boy refused to follow the rules.
words.ex_cn: 这个叛逆的男孩拒绝遵守规则。
words.en: If you think someone is rebellious, you mean that they are deliberately not obeying people in authority or rules of behaviour.

words.ex: He should not breakviolateoffend law.
words.ex_cn: 他不应该违反法律。

words.ex: The court punished the man for rape.
words.ex_cn: 法院因强奸罪惩罚了那个男人。
words.en: Rape is the crime of forcing someone to have sex with you, especially by using violence.

words.tr: adj. 凭冲动行事的；易冲动的
words.ex: He made an impulsive decision to quit his job.
words.ex_cn: 他一时冲动决定辞掉工作。
words.en: If you describe someone as impulsive, you mean that they do things suddenly without thinking about them carefully first.

words.ex: He is a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名老师。
words.en: Used to indicate the identity, qualities, or condition of someone or something.

words.ex: The man was punished for fraud.
words.ex_cn: 这个人因欺骗而受到惩罚。
words.en: Fraud is the crime of gaining money or financial benefits by a trick or by lying.

words.ex: He committed a crime last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚犯下一桩罪行。
words.en: To do something illegal or wrong.

words.ex: Some countries still use the death penalty.
words.ex_cn: 一些国家仍然使用死刑。
words.en: The death penalty is the legally authorized killing of someone as punishment for a crime.

words.ex: He returned to prison because of recidivism.
words.ex_cn: 他因再犯而重返监狱。
words.en: Recidivism is the act of repeating an undesirable behavior after having experienced negative consequences of that behavior.

words.tr: adj. 天真无邪的；无辜的；
words.ex: The innocent child smiled at the stranger.
words.ex_cn: 那个天真无邪的孩子对陌生人笑了。
words.en: If someone is innocent, they did not commit a crime which they have been accused of.

words.tr: phrase. 过分宽容的；过度放任的
words.ex: The teacher was criticized for being excessively permissive with the students.
words.ex_cn: 这位老师因对学生过度宽容而受到批评。
words.en: Allowing too much freedom, especially in a way that is not considered acceptable or appropriate.

words.ex: The storm deprived him of his power.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴使他失去了电力。
words.en: To take something away from someone; to prevent someone from having something.

words.ex: He has high self-esteem after passing the test.
words.ex_cn: 通过考试后，他自尊心很强。
words.en: Self-esteem is the opinion you have of yourself and your abilities.

words.tr: v. 撞击；对……有影响；侵犯
words.ex: The ball impinges on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 球撞击在墙上。

words.ex: He has a violent inclination to shout when angry.
words.ex_cn: 他一生气就有大喊大叫的倾向。
words.en: A tendency or predisposition towards aggressive or harmful behavior.

words.tr: phrase. 冒犯的、犯罪的、邪恶的

words.ex: The city is trying to reduce juvenile delinquency with after-school programs.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市正通过课后项目来减少青少年犯罪。
words.en: Juvenile delinquency refers to the participation in illegal behavior by minors (juveniles) who fall under a statutory age limit.

words.tr: phrase. 执法机构；负责执行法律的政府部门（如警察、联邦调查局等）
words.ex: The FBI is a well-known law enforcement agency in the United States.
words.ex_cn: 联邦调查局是美国一个著名的执法机构。
words.en: A law enforcement agency is an organization responsible for enforcing the laws, especially the police.

words.ex: He tried to instigate a fight at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他试图在聚会上挑起争斗。
words.en: If someone instigates an event or situation, they cause it to happen by their actions or behavior.

words.tr: adj. 可憎的；十恶不赦的
words.ex: He committed a heinous crime last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚犯下了一桩可怕的罪行。
words.en: If you describe something such as a crime as heinous, you mean that it is extremely evil or wicked.

words.ex: Children who show anti-social behaviors often ignore rules and hurt others.
words.ex_cn: 表现出反社会行为的孩子常常不遵守规则并伤害他人。

words.ex: The police investigated the assault on the old man.
words.ex_cn: 警方调查了对那位老人的攻击。
words.en: An assault is a physical attack on someone, or a military attack on a place.

words.ex: The boy got punishment for breaking the window.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩因为打碎了窗户而受到了处罚。
words.en: Punishment is the act of punishing someone or the state of being punished.

words.ex: The theft of the bike was reported to the police.
words.ex_cn: 这起自行车被盗事件已向警方报告。
words.en: Theft is the act of stealing.

words.tr: v. 制定（法律）；通过（法律）；扮演（角色）
words.ex: The government will enact a new law next month.
words.ex_cn: 政府下个月将颁布一项新法律。
words.en: To enact a law or rule means to make it official by passing it through a legislative body.

words.tr:
n. 材料；原料；
adj. 物质的；
words.ex: The table is made of wood material.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是由木头材料制成的。
words.en: Material refers to the substance or substances from which a thing is made or can be made, or information or ideas for use in creating a book or other work.

words.tr: adj. 严重的；严厉的；非常困难的；
words.ex: The storm caused severe damage to the houses.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴对房屋造成了严重的破坏。
words.en: If something is severe, it is very bad or very serious.

words.ex: The police caught the man after the burglary.
words.ex_cn: 警察在盗窃后抓住了那个男人。
words.en: Burglary is the crime of illegally entering a building and stealing things.

words.ex: The man was arrested for arson.
words.ex_cn: 这名男子因纵火被逮捕。
words.en: The crime of deliberately setting fire to property.

words.ex: He felt guilty for lying to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他因为对朋友撒谎而感到有罪。
words.en: If you feel guilty, you feel unhappy because you believe that you have done something wrong or have failed to do something which you should have done.

words.tr:
v. 吸引；诱惑；引诱
n. 诱惑；诱饵；吸引力
words.ex: The bright colors lure the birds to the feeder.
words.ex_cn: 鲜艳的颜色吸引鸟类来到喂食器。
words.en: If you lure someone, you tempt them to do something or to go somewhere, especially by offering some form of reward.

words.ex: He faced imprisonment for stealing money.
words.ex_cn: 他因偷钱而面临监禁。
words.en: The state of being confined in prison; the act of putting someone in prison or the condition of being kept in prison.

words.ex: There was clear hostility between the two neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 两个邻居之间明显存在敌意。
words.en: Hostility is unfriendly or aggressive behaviour towards people or ideas.

words.ex: Children must obey their parents.
words.ex_cn: 孩子必须遵守父母的规定。
words.en: To obey means to do what you are told or expected to do according to a rule, law, or someone with authority over you.

words.ex: Social problems affect many families.
words.ex_cn: 社会问题影响许多家庭。
words.en: Social means relating to society or to the way society is organized.

words.tr:
n. 滥用；虐待；辱骂；
v. 滥用；虐待；辱骂；
words.ex: The abuse of power led to many problems.
words.ex_cn: 权力的滥用导致了许多问题。
words.en: Abuse is the improper usage or treatment of a thing, often to unfairly or improperly gain benefit. Abuse can come in many forms, such as physical or verbal maltreatment, injury, assault, violation, rape, unjust practices, crimes, or other types of aggression.

words.ex: The police used surveillance to watch the building.
words.ex_cn: 警察使用监视来观察那栋大楼。
words.en: The careful watching of a person or place, especially by the police or army, because of a crime that has happened or is expected.

chapters.name: 写作词测 7（文化与全球化类）

words.ex: The immigrant found a job in the city.
words.ex_cn: 这位移民在城市里找到了一份工作。
words.en: An immigrant is a person who comes to live permanently in a foreign country.

words.tr: phrase. 战略合作；指在战略层面上的协作与配合
words.ex: The two companies have a strategic cooperation to share resources.
words.ex_cn: 两家公司有战略合作伙伴关系以共享资源。
words.en: Strategic cooperation refers to a planned and coordinated effort between two or more parties to achieve a common goal, often involving long-term planning and resource sharing.

words.tr: phrase. 有形文化遗产；指具有历史、艺术或科学价值的物质性文化遗存，如建筑、文物、手稿等
words.ex: The old temple is part of the tangible cultural heritage.
words.ex_cn: 这座古庙是有形文化遗产的一部分。
words.en: Tangible cultural heritage refers to physical artifacts, buildings, and sites that are of historical, cultural, or scientific significance.

words.ex: He has a monopoly on selling ice cream in this town.
words.ex_cn: 他在这座小镇上垄断了冰淇淋的销售。
words.en: If a company, person, or state has a monopoly on something such as an industry, they have complete control over it, so that it is impossible for others to become involved in it.

words.tr:
v. 设置；使固定；放置；
n. 一组；一套；
adj. 固定的；位于…的；安排好的；
words.ex: He set the alarm for 6 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他把闹钟设在早上六点。
words.en: To put something in a specified place or position; to adjust or arrange something; a group of things that belong together or are used together; fixed or established.

words.tr: phrase. 资本流动；指资金在国家或地区之间流入和流出的经济现象
words.ex: Capital flows into rich countries quickly.
words.ex_cn: 资本迅速流入富裕国家。
words.en: The movement of money for the purpose of investment, trade, or business production.

words.tr: phrase. 文化融合；文化整合
words.ex: The new family works hard for cultural integration.
words.ex_cn: 这个新家庭努力实现文化融合。
words.en: The process by which different cultural groups come together to form a cohesive society, often involving the blending of cultural practices, beliefs, and values.

words.ex: The factory tries to reduce producing cost.
words.ex_cn: 工厂试图降低生产成本。

words.tr: n. 血汗工厂； 活计苦累、工资低薄的工厂
words.ex: The documentary exposed the harsh conditions in sweatshops.
words.ex_cn: 这部纪录片揭露了血汗工厂的恶劣条件。
words.en: A sweatshop is a small factory where workers are paid very little and work long hours in poor conditions.

words.tr: phrase. 文化同化；指少数群体逐渐采纳主流文化的价值观、习俗和行为方式的过程
words.ex: Immigrants often face cultural assimilation in a new country.
words.ex_cn: 移民在新国家常常面临文化同化。
words.en: The process by which a minority group adopts the customs and attitudes of the dominant culture.

words.tr: adj. 综合的；整合的；融合的； v. 整合；结合；“integrate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The school offers an integrated science course.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校提供一门综合科学课程。
words.en: An integrated system or approach combines different groups or ideas in a way that works well.

words.ex: The city celebrates cultural diversity with many food festivals.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市通过许多美食节庆祝文化多样性。
words.en: Cultural diversity refers to the existence of a variety of cultural or ethnic groups within a society.

words.ex: The harmony between ethnic groups helps the country stay peaceful.
words.ex_cn: 民族之间的和谐有助于国家保持和平。
words.en: The state of peaceful coexistence and cooperation among different ethnic groups.

words.tr: phrase. 促进创新；推动革新
words.ex: The school helps to promote innovation in students.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校帮助促进学生的创新。
words.en: To encourage or support the development of new ideas, methods, or products.

words.ex: He is a descendant of the first king.
words.ex_cn: 他是第一位国王的后裔。
words.en: A person, plant, or animal that is descended from a particular ancestor.

words.tr: phrase. 多元文化理解；对不同文化背景人群的认知与包容
words.ex: He has multi-cultural understanding from living in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 他因为生活在许多国家而具有多元文化理解。
words.en: The ability to understand and appreciate the cultural differences and similarities among various groups in a society.

words.ex: The program aims to eliminate cultural conflicts between students.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目旨在消除学生之间的文化冲突。
words.en: To remove or get rid of cultural conflicts, often through understanding, communication, and mutual respect.

words.ex: The domestic enterprise sells products to local customers.
words.ex_cn: 这家国内企业向本地客户销售产品。

words.ex: The old temple is part of our cultural heritage.
words.ex_cn: 这座古庙是我们文化遗产的一部分。
words.en: Cultural heritage refers to the legacy of physical artifacts and intangible attributes of a group or society that are inherited from past generations, maintained in the present and bestowed for the benefit of future generations.

words.tr: n. 走私（罪）； v. “smuggle”的现在分词；
words.ex: Smuggling drugs is a serious crime.
words.ex_cn: 走私毒品是一种严重的犯罪。
words.en: The illegal movement of goods into or out of a country.

words.ex: Starting a new business brings opportunity and challenge.
words.ex_cn: 创业带来机遇与挑战。

words.ex: My ancestor came from China a hundred years ago.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖先一百年前来自中国。
words.en: An ancestor is a person from whom one is descended, typically more remote than a grandparent.

words.ex: Two companies made a joint venture to build a new factory.
words.ex_cn: 两家公司合作成立了一家合资企业来建造一座新工厂。
words.en: A joint venture is a business arrangement in which two or more parties agree to pool their resources for the purpose of accomplishing a specific task. This task can be a new project or any other business activity.

words.ex: He read a historical book about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一本关于古罗马的历史书。
words.en: Historical means relating to the study of history or connected with the past.

words.ex: The company plans to introduce overseas capitals to expand its business.
words.ex_cn: 该公司计划引入海外资本以扩大业务。

words.tr: adj. 最重要的；一流的；处于领导地位的； v. “lead”的现在分词；带领；领导；
words.ex: He is the leading scientist in this field.
words.ex_cn: 他是这个领域最重要的科学家。
words.en: If something is leading in a particular area, it is the most important or advanced thing in that area.

words.tr: phrase. 知识产权；智力成果权
words.ex: He protects his intellectual property with a patent.
words.ex_cn: 他用专利保护自己的知识产权。
words.en: Intellectual property refers to creations of the mind, such as inventions; literary and artistic works; designs; and symbols, names and images used in commerce.

words.tr: n. 习俗；习惯；关税；海关；“custom”的复数；
words.ex: In this village, it is a custom to light lanterns during the festival.
words.ex_cn: 在这个村庄，节日里点灯笼是一种习俗。
words.en: The place at a port, airport, or border where officials check the goods or luggage of people entering or leaving a country, and where they collect taxes on goods being imported.

words.tr: phrase. 人才外流；指受过高等教育或具有专业技能的人才大量移居国外的现象
words.ex: The country is experiencing a severe brain drain as many skilled professionals emigrate.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正经历着严重的智囊流失，因为许多专业人士正在移民。
words.en: The emigration of highly trained or intelligent people from a particular country.

words.tr: phrase. 文化同质化；指不同文化逐渐变得相似或统一的过程，通常受全球化和大众媒体影响
words.ex: Global brands cause cultural homogenization in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 全球品牌在许多国家导致文化同质化。
words.en: Cultural homogenization refers to the process by which local cultures are transformed or absorbed by a dominant outside culture, leading to a reduction in cultural diversity.

words.ex: The country worked hard to overcome trade barriers with its neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家努力克服与邻国的贸易壁垒。

words.tr: phrase. 濒临灭绝；处于灭绝的边缘
words.ex: Many animals are on the brinkedge of extinction due to pollution.
words.ex_cn: 许多动物因污染而濒临灭绝。

words.ex: The company uses an advanced management strategy to improve efficiency.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司使用高级管理策略来提高效率。

words.tr: adj. 海岛的；孤立的；思想褊狭的
words.ex: The insular village has no bridge to the mainland.
words.ex_cn: 这个海岛村庄没有桥通向大陆。
words.en: If you describe someone as insular, you are being critical of them because they are unwilling to meet new people or to consider new ideas.

words.ex: The company plans to expand international market by selling products online.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司计划通过在线销售来拓展国际市场。

words.ex: He overcame language barrier by practicing every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天练习克服了语言障碍。
words.en: To successfully communicate despite differences in language.

words.tr: n. 外包； v. “outsource”的现在分词；
words.ex: The company uses outsourcing to save money.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司通过外包来节省成本。
words.en: Outsourcing is the practice of obtaining goods or services from an outside or foreign supplier, especially in place of an internal source.

words.tr:
n. 进口；重要性；
v. 进口；
words.ex: The country increased its import of oil last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这个国家增加了石油的进口。
words.en: To bring in (goods or services) from a foreign country for sale or use.

words.w: cause the loss of cultural identity
words.tr: 短语. 导致文化认同感的丧失
words.uk: kɔːz ðə lɒs ɒv ˈkʌltʃərəl aɪˈdentəti
words.us: kɔːz ðə lɔːs ʌv ˈkʌltʃərəl aɪˈdɛntəti
words.ex: Immigration can cause the loss of cultural identity.
words.ex_cn: 移民可能导致文化身份的丧失。
words.en: To lead to the disappearance or weakening of the unique cultural characteristics of a group or community.

words.ex: The adaptation of animals to cold weather is amazing.
words.ex_cn: 动物对寒冷天气的适应令人惊叹。
words.en: An adaptation is a film, television drama, or stage play that is based on a written work.

chapters.name: 写作词测 8（旅游与动物保护类）

words.tr: adj. 令人惊异的；令人惊叹的； v. “amaze”的现在分词；
words.ex: The view from the mountain is amazing.
words.ex_cn: 从山上看到的景色令人惊异。
words.en: If something is amazing, it is very surprising and makes you feel pleasure or admiration.

words.tr: phrase. 稀有物种；濒危物种
words.ex: The panda is a rare species.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫是一种稀有物种。
words.en: A rare species is a group of organisms that are very uncommon, scarce, or infrequently encountered, often due to their limited numbers or restricted habitat.

words.tr: phrase. 享受生存存在的权利
words.ex: All people should enjoy the right of survivalexistence.
words.ex_cn: 所有人都应该享受生存存在的权利。

words.ex: Tourism brings money to small towns.
words.ex_cn: 旅游业为小镇带来收入。
words.en: Tourism is the business of providing services for people on holiday, for example hotels, restaurants, and trips.

words.ex: Many species are endangered due to habitat loss.
words.ex_cn: 许多物种因栖息地丧失而处于危险之中。
words.en: To be in a situation where one is at risk of harm or extinction.

words.ex: The bright flowers attract bees.
words.ex_cn: 鲜艳的花朵吸引蜜蜂。
words.en: If something or someone attracts you, they have particular qualities which cause you to like or admire them.

words.tr: phrase. 消除误解；清除误会
words.ex: She talks clearly to eliminate misunderstandings.
words.ex_cn: 她说话清晰以消除误解。
words.en: To remove or get rid of misunderstandings, ensuring clear and accurate communication.

words.ex: The cruel king punished the innocent people.
words.ex_cn: 残酷的国王惩罚了无辜的人。
words.en: Someone who is cruel deliberately causes pain or distress to others or feels no concern about it.

words.ex: Pandas are endangered species.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫是濒危物种。
words.en: An endangered species is a type of organism that is at risk of extinction due to a rapid decrease in its population or a loss of its critical habitat.

words.ex: The landscape after the rain is very beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 雨后的景色非常美丽。
words.en: A landscape is all the visible features of an area of land, often considered in terms of their aesthetic appeal.

words.tr:
n. 麻醉剂；麻醉药
adj. 麻醉的
words.ex: The doctor gave him an anesthetic before the surgery.
words.ex_cn: 医生在手术前给他用了麻醉剂。
words.en: An anesthetic is a substance that causes loss of sensation or consciousness, used especially to prevent pain during medical procedures.

words.tr: v. 商业化，使商业化：组织或改变以追求盈利。
words.ex: The festival became commercialised after big brands joined.
words.ex_cn: 大品牌加入后，这个节日变得商业化了。
words.en: Made something available for commercial purposes; turned into a business opportunity.

words.ex: They learned about cultural traditions during the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他们在旅行中了解了文化传统。
words.en: Relating to the ideas, customs, and social behavior of a society.

words.ex: He opposes vivisection because it hurts animals.
words.ex_cn: 他反对活体解剖，因为这会伤害动物。
words.en: The practice of performing operations on live animals for the purpose of experimentation or scientific research (often considered to be cruel).

words.ex: The panda lives in its natural habitat.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫生活在它的自然栖息地中。
words.en: The natural environment in which an organism or a community normally lives or occurs.

words.tr: phrase. 开拓某人的视野；使某人的眼界更开阔
words.ex: Traveling abroad can expand one's horizons.
words.ex_cn: 出国旅行可以拓宽一个人的视野。
words.en: To broaden one's understanding, experience, or knowledge.

words.tr: phrase. 海洋动物；生活在海洋中的动物
words.ex: Marine animals live in the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 海洋动物生活在海洋中。
words.en: Marine animals are organisms that live in the ocean or depend on the ocean for their survival.

words.tr: phrase. 动物偷猎；非法捕猎野生动物的行为
words.ex: Poachers kill animals for their fur and tusks.
words.ex_cn: 偷猎者为了皮毛和象牙猎杀动物。
words.en: The illegal hunting or capturing of wild animals, typically associated with the illegal wildlife trade.

words.ex: The doctor studied animal organs to understand human bodies.
words.ex_cn: 医生研究动物器官以了解人体。
words.en: The internal parts of an animal's body that perform specific functions.

words.tr: phrase. 促进经济增长；推动经济扩张
words.ex: Good policies can boost economic growth.
words.ex_cn: 好的政策可以促进经济增长。
words.en: Increase the rate of economic development or expansion.

words.ex: They work for animal protection every day.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天为动物保护而工作。
words.en: The act of safeguarding animals from harm, abuse, and exploitation, ensuring their welfare and rights are respected.

words.tr: adj. 不同的；多种多样的；
words.ex: The class has diverse students from many countries.
words.ex_cn: 这个班级有来自许多国家的不同学生。
words.en: If a group or range of things is diverse, it is made up of a wide variety of things.

words.ex: He lost his instincts after years in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他在城市里待了几年后失去了直觉。
words.en: To lose natural, inborn behaviors or responses.

words.ex: The ocean's biologic chain includes fish and plankton.
words.ex_cn: 海洋的生物链包括鱼和浮游生物。

words.ex: The new factory will create job opportunities for local people.
words.ex_cn: 这家新工厂将为当地人创造就业机会。
words.en: To make new employment possibilities available, especially by establishing new businesses or industries.

words.ex: This painting is unique because no other like it exists.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是独特的，因为没有其他类似的。
words.en: Something that is unique is the only one of its kind.

words.tr: phrase. 动物被囚禁的状态；动物 captivity 指动物被人类关养或限制自由的处境
words.ex: Many people think animal captivity is not good for wild animals.
words.ex_cn: 许多人认为动物被关在笼子里对野生动物不好。
words.en: The state of being confined or held in a controlled environment, typically referring to animals kept in zoos, aquariums, or other enclosures.

words.tr: v. 对……造成破坏性影响
words.ex: Pollution can cause destructive impacts on fish habitats.
words.ex_cn: 污染会对鱼类的栖息地造成破坏性影响。
words.en: To produce damaging effects on something or someone.

words.tr: adj. 历史悠久的；由来已久的
words.ex: This is a time-honoured tradition in our family.
words.ex_cn: 这是我们家族历史悠久的传统。
words.en: Respected or valued because it has existed for a long time.

words.tr: v. 实现唯利是图的目的；达成以金钱利益为动机的目标
words.ex: He worked hard to achieve mercenary purpose.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以实现牟利的目的。
words.en: To accomplish a goal driven by selfish or materialistic motives.

words.ex: The Great Wall is a famous tourist attraction.
words.ex_cn: 长城是一个著名的游览胜地。
words.en: A place of interest where tourists visit, typically for its inherent or exhibited natural or cultural value, historical significance, natural or built beauty, offering leisure, adventure, and amusement.

words.tr: n. 对动物的剥削；利用动物谋取利益
words.ex: People are fighting against the exploitation of animals.
words.ex_cn: 人们正在反对对动物的剥削。
words.en: The act of using animals in a way that is considered harmful or unethical.

words.tr: phrase. 提高对传统文化的认识
words.ex: The school tries to raise awareness of traditional culture.
words.ex_cn: 学校试图提高对传统文化的认识。

words.ex: We must ensure ecologic balance.
words.ex_cn: 我们必须确保生态平衡。

words.ex: He had to endure torture and suffering during the war.
words.ex_cn: 他在战争期间不得不忍受折磨和痛苦。
words.en: To experience severe physical or mental pain and distress.

words.tr: phrase. 促进文化交流；推动文化沟通
words.ex: The festival helps to promote cultural communication.
words.ex_cn: 这个节日有助于促进文化交流。
words.en: To encourage and facilitate the exchange of cultural ideas and practices between different groups or societies.

words.tr: phrase. 维持生物多样性；保持生态多样性
words.ex: We must maintain biodiversity in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 我们必须保持森林中的生物多样性。
words.en: To maintain biodiversity means to preserve the variety of life forms in a particular habitat or ecosystem, ensuring the balance and health of the environment.

words.tr: v. 深入了解；深刻理解
words.ex: He read the book to get a deep insight into human behavior.
words.ex_cn: 他读了这本书，以深入了解人类行为。
words.en: To gain a profound and thorough understanding of a subject, issue, or situation.

chapters.name: 写作词测 9（家庭与性别类）

words.ex: Parents often spoil their children with too many toys.
words.ex_cn: 父母经常用太多玩具宠坏孩子。
words.en: To spoil something means to reduce its quality or value, often by damaging it in some way. It can also mean to treat someone, especially a child, with too much kindness or indulgence, leading to their detriment.

words.ex: She faced gender discrimination at work.
words.ex_cn: 她在工作中遭遇了性别歧视。
words.en: Gender discrimination refers to the unfair treatment of individuals or groups based on their gender, especially in the workplace or in educational settings.

words.tr: phrase. 陪伴家人；陪同家庭成员
words.ex: I will accompany my parents to the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 我会陪我的父母去医院。
words.en: To go with or be present with members of one's family.

words.ex: He has prejudice against people from other countries.
words.ex_cn: 他对来自其他国家的人有偏见。
words.en: Prejudice is an unreasonable dislike of a particular group of people or things, or a preference for one group of people or things over another.

words.tr: phrase. 人际交往能力；人际沟通技巧
words.ex: He has good interpersonal skills.
words.ex_cn: 他有良好的人际交往能力。
words.en: The ability to communicate or interact well with other people.

words.tr: phrase. 贫困家庭；经济拮据的家庭
words.ex: He grew up in an impoverished family but worked hard to succeed.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在一个贫困的家庭，但通过努力取得了成功。
words.en: An impoverished family is a family that is extremely poor and lacks the basic necessities of life.

words.ex: Family closeness is important for children's emotional development.
words.ex_cn: 家庭亲密关系对儿童的情感发展很重要。
words.en: The state of being emotionally connected and intimate within a family.

words.ex: He is a well-educated man who works at a university.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位受过良好教育的男子，在大学工作。
words.en: Someone who is well-educated has received a good education and has a lot of knowledge.

words.ex: The unfairness of the tax system has been widely criticized.
words.ex_cn: 税收制度的不公平性受到了广泛的批评。
words.en: The quality of being unjust or inequitable.

words.tr: phrase. 弥合代沟；克服代际差异
words.ex: Parents and children can overcome generation gap by talking more.
words.ex_cn: 父母和孩子可以通过多交流来克服代沟。
words.en: To successfully deal with and reduce the differences in opinions, attitudes, and behaviors between different generations.

words.ex: Everyone deserves equality in education.
words.ex_cn: 每个人都应享有教育平等。
words.en: Equality is the state of being equal, especially in status, rights, or opportunities.

words.tr: phrase. 家庭疏离；家庭关系中的情感疏远或隔阂
words.ex: The parents felt family alienation after the argument.
words.ex_cn: 争吵之后，父母感受到了家庭疏离。
words.en: The state of being estranged or separated from one's family, often resulting in emotional distance and lack of communication.

words.ex: He has high self-esteem after passing the test.
words.ex_cn: 通过考试后，他自尊心很强。
words.en: Self-esteem is the opinion you have of yourself and your abilities.

words.ex: We must eliminate stereotypical thinking to understand people better.
words.ex_cn: 我们必须消除刻板印象，才能更好地理解他人。
words.en: Remove or challenge preconceived and oversimplified ideas about groups of people, promoting fairer judgment.

words.tr: adj. 考虑周到的；体贴的；
words.ex: He is considerate and always asks if others need help.
words.ex_cn: 他很体贴，总是问别人是否需要帮助。
words.en: Someone who is considerate pays attention to the needs, wishes, or feelings of other people.

words.tr: phrase. 使某人从…中解放出来；使某人摆脱…；把某人从…中释放出来
words.ex: The new law will liberate children from hard work.
words.ex_cn: 新法律将使孩子们从繁重的工作中解放出来。
words.en: To free someone from a situation or condition that restricts their freedom or development.

words.ex: She feels the sense of belonging in her small town.
words.ex_cn: 她在小镇上感受到了归属感。
words.en: The feeling of being accepted and included in a group or community.

words.tr: adj. 明智的；有判断力的；恰当的；合理的；
words.ex: It is sensible to wear a coat in cold weather.
words.ex_cn: 在寒冷的天气里穿外套是明智的。
words.en: A sensible person is able to make good judgments and decisions based on reason rather than emotion.

words.ex: He mistreats his dog every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天虐待他的狗。
words.en: To treat someone or something in a cruel, harsh, or unfair way.

words.ex: He won social recognition for helping the poor.
words.ex_cn: 他因帮助穷人而获得了社会认可。
words.en: Gain acceptance, respect, or approval from the community or society for one's actions or achievements.

words.ex: My teacher is my role model.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师是我的榜样。
words.en: A role model is a person whose behavior, example, or success is or can be emulated by others, especially by younger people.

words.ex: He called the police because of domestic violence.
words.ex_cn: 他因为家庭暴力报了警。
words.en: Domestic violence refers to violent or aggressive behavior within the home, typically involving the violent abuse of a spouse or partner.

words.tr: phrase. 道德教育；品德教育
words.ex: Schools give moral education to help children be kind.
words.ex_cn: 学校进行道德教育，帮助孩子们变得善良。
words.en: Moral education refers to the teaching of values and ethics to students, aiming to develop their moral reasoning and behavior.

words.ex: I need to squeeze time to study for the test.
words.ex_cn: 我需要挤出时间来准备考试。

words.tr: phrase. 加强家庭纽带；增进家庭成员间的情感联系
words.ex: We should spend more time together to strengthen family bond.
words.ex_cn: 我们应该花更多的时间在一起，以加强家庭纽带。
words.en: To enhance the emotional connection and unity among family members.

words.tr: phrase. 在家庭成员之间保持联系
words.ex: They call every Sunday to maintain contact among family members.
words.ex_cn: 他们每周日打电话以保持家人之间的联系。
words.en: To keep in regular communication and connection with family members.

words.ex: His politeness made everyone feel welcome.
words.ex_cn: 他的礼貌让每个人都感到受欢迎。
words.en: Politeness is the practical application of good manners or etiquette so as not to offend others.

words.tr: phrase. 剥夺某人空闲时间
words.ex: The long hours deprive him of leisure time.
words.ex_cn: 长时间工作剥夺了他的闲暇时间。
words.en: To prevent someone from having free time for relaxation or enjoyment.

words.tr: phrase. 不当的育儿方式；不恰当的教养方式
words.ex: Improper parenting can make children feel unsafe.
words.ex_cn: 不当的育儿方式会让孩子感到不安全。
words.en: The act of raising a child in a way that is not appropriate or beneficial.

words.ex: He felt self-abased after the failure of his project.
words.ex_cn: adj. 在他的项目失败后，他感到自卑。
words.en: Feeling or showing a low estimate of one's own importance; self-deprecating.

words.ex: The affluent family bought a big house by the lake.
words.ex_cn: 这个富裕的家庭在湖边买了一栋大房子。
words.en: Having a great deal of money; wealthy.

words.tr: n. 依恋；附件；附加装置；
words.ex: The child showed strong attachment to his teddy bear.
words.ex_cn: 孩子对他的泰迪熊产生了强烈的依恋。
words.en: An attachment is a file that is sent along with an email message.

words.tr: adj. 攻击性的；有进取心的；侵略性的；
words.ex: The dog showed aggressive behavior toward strangers.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗对陌生人表现出攻击性行为。
words.en: An aggressive person or animal has a quality of anger and determination that makes them ready to attack others.

words.ex: We had a family reunion last Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们上个星期天举行了家庭聚会。
words.en: A family reunion is a gathering of family members, often extended family, who come together to celebrate their familial bonds, share memories, and enjoy each other's company. These events are typically organized on a regular basis, such as annually, and can take place in various locations, including family homes, parks, or rented venues.

words.ex: The weather is mild today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天气温和。
words.en: Mild is used to describe something that is not extreme, severe, or strong, such as weather, taste, or behavior.

words.uk: ðə ɪnˈfɪər.iə r ˈsteɪt.əs əv wɪm.ɪn
words.ex: She fought against the inferior status of women in her country.
words.ex_cn: 她为反对本国女性的低下地位而斗争。
words.en: The state of being considered less important or lower in rank than men, often resulting in unequal treatment and opportunities.

words.ex: He works hard to promote social status.
words.ex_cn: 他努力提升社会地位。
words.en: To advance or improve one's standing or position in society.

words.tr: adj. 凭冲动行事的；易冲动的
words.ex: He made an impulsive decision to quit his job.
words.ex_cn: 他一时冲动决定辞掉工作。
words.en: If you describe someone as impulsive, you mean that they do things suddenly without thinking about them carefully first.

words.ex: He gave an emotional speech about his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他发表了一篇关于他母亲的感人演讲。
words.en: Something that is emotional is connected with people's feelings. If someone is emotional, they show their feelings very openly, especially because they are upset.

words.tr:
n. 病人；
adj. 有耐心的；
words.ex: The doctor helped the patient feel better.
words.ex_cn: 医生帮助病人感觉好些了。
words.en: A patient person is able to wait for a long time or deal with a difficult situation without becoming angry or upset.

words.tr: adj. 感伤的；感情的；多愁善感的
words.ex: He kept the old toy because he was sentimental about it.
words.ex_cn: 他保留了那个旧玩具，因为他对它有感情。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as sentimental, you mean that they are influenced by emotional feelings, especially about happy memories of past events or relationships with other people, rather than by careful thought and judgment based on facts.

words.tr: adj. 穷困的；赤穷的；贫瘠的； v. “impoverish”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The impoverished family lived in a small house with no heating.
words.ex_cn: 这个贫困的家庭住在一个没有暖气的小房子里。
words.en: An impoverished person or area is very poor.

words.ex: He has diabetes and must check his blood every day.
words.ex_cn: 他患有糖尿病，必须每天检查血糖。
words.en: A medical condition in which the body cannot produce enough insulin or cannot use insulin properly, leading to high levels of sugar in the blood.

words.tr: adj. 负面的；消极的；否定的；
words.ex: The news had a negative effect on the market.
words.ex_cn: 这条新闻对市场产生了负面影响。
words.en: If someone is negative or has a negative attitude, they consider only the bad aspects of a situation, rather than the good ones.

words.tr: phrase. 急性的疾病；指发病迅速、症状严重但通常持续时间较短的疾病
words.ex: He was hospitalized for acute diseases like flu and pneumonia.
words.ex_cn: 他因流感和肺炎等急性疾病住院。
words.en: Acute diseases are conditions that develop rapidly and are accompanied by distinct symptoms that require urgent care.

words.ex: They enjoy retirement years by traveling and gardening.
words.ex_cn: 他们通过旅行和园艺享受退休生活。
words.en: To experience pleasure and satisfaction during the period after one stops working.

words.ex: He needs instant medical treatment after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后需要立即接受医疗救治。
words.en: Immediate healthcare provided without delay, typically in emergencies or urgent situations.

words.tr: adj. 孤独的；寂寞的；偏僻的；
words.ex: He felt lonely after his dog died.
words.ex_cn: 他的狗去世后，他感到孤独。
words.en: If you are lonely, you are unhappy because you are alone or do not have anyone you can talk to.

words.tr: phrase. 预期寿命；平均寿命
words.ex: Life expectancy has increased in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 许多国家的预期寿命已经增加。
words.en: The average period that a person may expect to live.

words.tr: phrase. 向年轻人传授知识
words.ex: Teachers impart knowledge to youngsters every day.
words.ex_cn: 老师每天向年轻人传授知识。
words.en: Transfer knowledge and information to young people.

words.tr: phrase. 慢性疾病；长期持续的疾病
words.ex: He has chronic diseases and needs medicine every day.
words.ex_cn: 他患有慢性病，每天都需要吃药。
words.en: Chronic diseases are conditions that last 1 year or more and require ongoing medical attention or limit activities of daily living or both.

words.tr: n. 空巢（指子女长大离家后父母独居的家庭状况）
words.ex: After their children moved out for college, they became empty-nesters.
words.ex_cn: n. 他们的孩子上大学搬出去后，他们成了空巢家庭。
words.en: A term used to describe the situation in which parents live alone after their children have grown up and left home.

words.ex: He showed filial love by taking care of his old parents.
words.ex_cn: 他通过照顾年迈的父母表现出子女的孝心。
words.en: Filial is used to describe the relationship between children and their parents, especially emphasizing the duty and respect that children should show towards their parents.

words.tr: n. 养老金；退休金；抚恤金；
words.ex: He receives a monthly pension after retiring.
words.ex_cn: 他退休后每月领取养老金。
words.en: A pension is a sum of money which a retired, widowed, or disabled person regularly receives from the state or from a former employer.

words.ex: He has hypertension and takes medicine every day.
words.ex_cn: 他有高血压，每天吃药。
words.en: Hypertension is a condition in which the force of the blood against the artery walls is too high.

words.tr: adj. 瘫痪的；麻痹的； v. “paralyze”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The accident left him paralyzed.
words.ex_cn: 这场事故使他瘫痪了。
words.en: Unable to move or act; rendered powerless or ineffective.

words.ex: He has a regular physical check every year.
words.ex_cn: 他每年进行一次常规体检。
words.en: A routine examination of one's body by a medical professional to assess overall health.

words.ex: Eating healthy food helps with longevity.
words.ex_cn: 健康饮食有助于长寿。
words.en: Longevity refers to the length or duration of an individual's life, especially when it is unusually long.

words.ex: He plans to start his retirement next year.
words.ex_cn: 他计划明年退休。
words.en: Retirement is the period of one's life after leaving one's job and ceasing to work.

words.ex: They live together with children in a small house.
words.ex_cn: 他们和孩子们一起住在一所小房子里。
words.en: To cohabit in the same household with one's offspring.

words.tr: adj. 空虚的；茫然的；空洞的
words.ex: His vacuous smile made no sense.
words.ex_cn: 他空洞的微笑毫无意义。
words.en: If you describe someone's mind or smile as vacuous, you are critical of them because they lack intelligence, understanding, or seriousness.

words.ex: The child has malnutrition from not eating enough food.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子因为吃不够饭而营养不良。
words.en: Malnutrition is a condition that results from eating a diet in which certain nutrients are lacking, in excess (too high in intake), or in the wrong proportions.

words.ex: He works hard to achieve personal value.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以实现个人价值。
words.en: Accomplish or fulfill a sense of purpose, meaning, or satisfaction derived from one's own efforts and life choices.

words.tr: adj. 过时的；老式的； v. “outmode”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: This phone is outmoded and needs to be replaced.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机已经过时了，需要更换。
words.en: If you describe something as outmoded, you mean that you think it is old-fashioned and no longer useful or relevant to modern life.

words.ex: The old man has senile dementia.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人患有老年痴呆症。
words.en: A progressive mental disorder characterized by declining memory and cognitive function, primarily affecting older adults.

words.tr: phrase. 社区诊所；为特定社区居民提供基本医疗服务的医疗机构
words.ex: She goes to the community clinic for free checkups.
words.ex_cn: 她去社区诊所做免费检查。
words.en: A community clinic is a healthcare facility that provides basic medical services to the local population, often focusing on preventive care and treatment of common illnesses.

words.ex: The longevial tree has stood for centuries.
words.ex_cn: 这棵长寿的树已经矗立了几个世纪。

words.ex: The government helps poor people with social welfare.
words.ex_cn: 政府通过社会福利帮助穷人。
words.en: Social welfare refers to the well-being of a society, often provided through government programs aimed at helping those in need.

words.ex: The hotel has good entertainment and fitness facilities.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店有很好的娱乐和健身设施。
words.en: Venues and services for recreation and physical health.

words.tr: v. 积累并分享人生经验
words.ex: Old people accumulate and share life experience with their grandchildren.
words.ex_cn: 老人积累并和孙辈分享人生经验。
words.en: To gather and exchange personal stories and wisdom gained from living.

words.ex: He feels weak after the long illness.
words.ex_cn: 这场大病之后，他感到虚弱。
words.en: If someone is weak, they are not physically strong or healthy.

words.ex: This is the book I bought.
words.ex_cn: 这是我自己买的那本书。
words.en: used to refer to a specific person or thing that has already been mentioned or is known about

words.w: relieve the financial burden of government
words.tr: phrase. 减轻政府的财政负担
words.ex: This policy helps relieve the financial burden of government.
words.ex_cn: 这项政策有助于减轻政府的财政负担。

chapters.name: 写作词测 11（就业与食品类）

words.tr: phrase. 油腻的食物；指含有大量油脂、吃起来感觉滑腻的食物
words.ex: He avoids greasy food because it makes him sick.
words.ex_cn: 他避免吃油腻的食物，因为吃了会让他不舒服。
words.en: Food that is high in fat and oil, often considered unhealthy.

words.ex: The room was in complete disorder.
words.ex_cn: 房间一片混乱。
words.en: A disorder is a state of confusion or untidiness, or a medical problem that affects the mind or body.

words.tr: phrase. 培养人际交往能力
words.ex: Parents should nurture interpersonal skills in children.
words.ex_cn: 父母应该培养孩子的社交技能。
words.en: Develop and cultivate the ability to interact effectively with others.

words.ex: Cross-national business trade grows when countries work together.
words.ex_cn: 当国家合作时，跨国商业贸易就会增长。
words.en: Commercial exchange of goods and services between businesses in different countries.

words.ex: He has insomnia and cannot sleep at night.
words.ex_cn: 他有失眠症，晚上睡不着。
words.en: If someone suffers from insomnia, they find it difficult to sleep.

words.ex: Farmers grow corn as a crop.
words.ex_cn: 农民种植玉米作为农作物。
words.en: A crop is a plant such as wheat, potatoes, or cotton that is grown in large quantities by farmers.

words.ex: The job is repetitive and boring.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作重复且无聊。
words.en: Something that is repetitive involves doing the same thing over and over again.

words.ex: Eating vegetables gives you good nutrition.
words.ex_cn: 吃蔬菜能提供良好的营养。
words.en: The process of providing or obtaining the food necessary for health and growth.

words.tr: phrase. 职位晋升；工作升迁
words.ex: He got a job promotion last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月得到了职位晋升。
words.en: The advancement of an employee to a higher position within a company, typically accompanied by increased responsibilities and salary.

words.ex: He works overtime to earn more money.
words.ex_cn: 他加班赚更多钱。
words.en: To work beyond the regular working hours, often to complete tasks or meet deadlines.

words.ex: This apple has about 95 calories.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果大约有95卡路里。
words.en: A calorie is a unit of energy, often used as a measurement of the amount of energy that food provides.

words.tr: adj. 筋疲力尽的；耗尽的； v. 耗尽；用完；“exhaust”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was exhausted after running five kilometers.
words.ex_cn: 他跑完五公里后筋疲力尽。
words.en: If you are exhausted, you are very tired and have no energy left.
