words.tr: phrase. 食品防腐剂（用于防止食物腐败变质的化学或天然物质）
words.ex: Some food preservatives make snacks last longer.
words.ex_cn: 一些食品防腐剂能让零食保存更久。
words.en: Substances added to food to prevent spoilage and extend shelf life.

words.ex: He sacrifices his spare time to help his brother with homework.
words.ex_cn: 他牺牲自己的空闲时间帮助弟弟做作业。
words.en: To give up free time for a purpose.

words.tr: adj. 单调乏味的；毫无变化的；
words.ex: The work is monotonous and boring.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作单调乏味。
words.en: Something that is monotonous is very boring because it has a regular, repeated pattern which never changes.

words.ex: Farmers grow grain like wheat and rice.
words.ex_cn: 农民种植小麦和大米等谷物。
words.en: A grain is a small, hard seed of a food plant such as wheat, rice, or corn, or the plant itself.

words.tr: v. 维持生计；保持基本生存所需
words.ex: He works hard to maintain subsistence for his family.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以维持家人的生计。
words.en: To sustain a basic level of living or existence, often with minimal resources.

words.tr: n. 关税；税率；（旅馆、饭店等的）价目表
words.ex: The government raised the tariff on imported cars.
words.ex_cn: 政府提高了进口汽车的关税。
words.en: A tariff is a tax that a government collects on goods coming into a country.

words.ex: He felt the sense of satisfaction after finishing his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他做完作业后感到一种满足感。
words.en: A feeling of contentment and fulfillment.

words.ex: He eats fiber to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他吃纤维来保持健康。
words.en: A fiber is a thread or a structure or object resembling a thread, especially one that is used to make cloth or rope.

words.ex: She buys organic food at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上购买有机食品。
words.en: Food produced without the use of chemical fertilizers, pesticides, or other artificial chemicals.

words.ex: The exam was stressful for all students.
words.ex_cn: 这次考试对所有学生来说压力很大。
words.en: If a situation or experience is stressful, it makes you feel worried and tense because of difficulties or problems.

words.tr:
v. 生产；获利；
n. 产量；
words.ex: This farm yields a lot of wheat each year.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场每年生产大量小麦。
words.en: If you yield to someone or something, you stop resisting them. If a tree or plant yields fruit or flowers, it produces them.

words.tr: phrase. 食品添加剂；用于改善食品品质、延长保质期或增加营养成分的物质
words.ex: Some food additives are used to keep food fresh.
words.ex_cn: 一些食品添加剂用于保持食物新鲜。
words.en: Substances added to food to preserve flavor or enhance its taste and appearance.

words.ex: Obesity is a serious health problem in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 肥胖是许多国家的一个严重健康问题。
words.en: Obesity is a medical condition in which excess body fat has accumulated to the extent that it may have a negative effect on health.

words.tr: v. 展示某人的才能和技能
words.ex: He will demonstrate his talent and skills in the competition.
words.ex_cn: 他将在比赛中展示自己的才华和技能。
words.en: To show or prove one's abilities and expertise.

words.ex: The village suffered from famine last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这个村庄遭受了饥荒。
words.en: A famine is a serious shortage of food in a country, which may cause many people to get sick or die.

words.ex: The government checks food safety in all restaurants.
words.ex_cn: 政府检查所有餐厅的食品安全。
words.en: The condition of food being safe to eat, not contaminated with harmful substances.

words.tr: phrase. 发挥某人的潜能；施展潜力
words.ex: He tries to exert his potential in sports.
words.ex_cn: 他努力在运动中发挥自己的潜力。
words.en: To use or apply one's full abilities and capabilities.

words.ex: The company improved its logistics to deliver packages faster.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司改进了物流，以更快地配送包裹。
words.en: Logistics refers to the detailed organization and implementation of a complex operation.

words.ex: The nonprofit aims to achieve social value by helping the poor.
words.ex_cn: 这家非营利组织旨在通过帮助穷人实现社会价值。
words.en: To gain worth or importance in society.

words.ex: Good hygiene helps prevent sickness.
words.ex_cn: 良好的卫生有助于预防疾病。
words.en: Hygiene refers to conditions and practices that help to maintain health and prevent the spread of diseases.

words.ex: He wore a decent shirt to the interview.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一件像样的衬衫去面试。
words.en: Decent is used to describe something which is considered to be of an acceptable standard or quality.

words.tr:
n. 收获；收成；
v. 收获；收割；
words.ex: The farmers celebrated the harvest in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 农民们在秋天庆祝收获。
words.en: The harvest is the process of gathering mature crops from the fields. It is a crucial activity in agriculture that marks the end of the growing season.

words.tr: v. 提高某人的独立性
words.ex: He tries to improve his independence by doing chores every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天做家务来提高自己的独立性。
words.en: To enhance one's ability to act independently.

words.ex: The river suffered from contamination after the factory dumped waste.
words.ex_cn: 工厂倾倒废物后，这条河受到了污染。
words.en: The process of making something dirty or polluted, or the state of being dirty or polluted.

words.ex: He tries to balance work and life by going home early.
words.ex_cn: 他通过早点回家来平衡工作和生活。
words.en: To balance work and life means to manage one's time and energy between work and personal life effectively to achieve satisfaction in both areas.

words.tr:
n. 脂肪；
adj. 肥的；
words.ex: This food has too much fat.
words.ex_cn: 这种食物含有太多脂肪。
words.en: Fat is a substance contained in foods such as meat, cheese, and butter, which is used by the body to produce energy or stored in the body as a layer.

words.ex: Climbing the mountain was an arduous task.
words.ex_cn: 爬山是一项艰巨的任务。
words.en: Something that is arduous is difficult and tiring, and involves a lot of effort.

words.tr: phrase. 速食食品；即食食品；方便食品
words.ex: He eats instant food when he is busy.
words.ex_cn: 他忙的时候吃即食食品。
words.en: Food that is prepared and ready to eat with minimal additional preparation.

words.ex: The manager gave a speech to stimulate working enthusiasm.
words.ex_cn: 经理发表了一番演讲来激发工作热情。
words.en: To encourage or increase eagerness and energy for work.

words.tr: adj. 工资高的（工作）；收入高的（人）
words.ex: He is a well-paid engineer.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名高薪的工程师。
words.en: A well-paid job or position is one for which you are paid a lot of money.

words.ex: Good digestion helps your body absorb nutrients.
words.ex_cn: 良好的消化有助于身体吸收营养。
words.en: The process by which food is broken down in the stomach and intestines so that the body can absorb it and use it for energy and nutrients.

words.tr: phrase. 施肥的食物；受精的食物
words.ex: Farmers grow fertilized food for the market.
words.ex_cn: 农民为市场种植施肥的食物。

words.tr: phrase. 追求职业发展；致力于职业生涯的进步与提升
words.ex: He wants to pursue career development after graduation.
words.ex_cn: 他想在毕业后追求职业发展。
words.en: To seek advancement and growth in one's professional life.

words.ex: He eats canned food for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃罐头食品。
words.en: Food that has been processed and sealed in a can or jar to preserve it.

words.tr: phrase. 垃圾食品；无营养食品
words.ex: He eats junk food every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都吃垃圾食品。
words.en: Food that is unhealthy but is quick and easy to eat.
